about_the_game:
KrvVR puts you into a fast-paced VR martial arts arena where survival demands every punch and dodge. Crush enemies with your fists, wield unique weapons and unleash abilities. Your real-world moves fuel progress, making every bout a true physical challenge. Your progress resets everyday to encourage daily exercise.

Fast-Paced Combat

Face a flood of monsters and dodge obstacles in a responsive combat system. Time your strikes and actions with precision as enemies get faster and increase in numbers, pushing your reflexes to the max.

Weapons and Abilities

Wield swords, bows, staffs or spells like fireballs and tornadoes. Slice foes with a sword, freeze them with ice or whip up a whirlwind and more! Each tool helps you sustain on the battlefield.

Survival and Sustain

Staying alive in KrvVR is no joke. Grab rare food drops to heal up mid-fight, but stay sharp. Enemies hit hard and missing a pickup or a failure to strike could be a game over.

Spiritual Realms

New stages apart from unique visuals, come with new abilities, enemies and consumables. Everyday climb your way to the final stage where everything is available to use in an endless mode.

Exercise is Progress

Everyday your progress resets, encouraging daily exercise and effort to climb your way back. KrvVR tracks your punches and dodges, estimating calorie burn based on height and speed. The more you move and the harder you strike, the quicker you unlock new arenas and challenges. It's a workout that feels like a brawl.

Rising Difficulty

Enemies swarm in bigger waves and move faster. Hazards and obstacles keep you guessing, forcing you to sharpen your skills and strategy to survive each round. 

Jump into KrvVR and throw some punches!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 Sandy Bridge or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 960 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR (Tested with Quest 2)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 Skylake or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR (Tested with Quest 2)
